BITD.Warning: Be aware, this will clear all Heat/Wanted
BITD.KeysExplanation: Each of your 5 Keys tracks marks (0-3) as you lean into that part of your character's history or identity. When a Key hits 3 marks, you can boom it into a Deadlock — a lasting complication tied to that Key.
BITD.NoCatalogDeadlocks: No catalog deadlocks for this Key — enter a custom one above.
BITD.CrewTypeBox: Click to choose a Crew Type
BITD.ChooseOneOrTwoEdges: Choose one or two edges and an equal number of flaws
BITD.AddAdditionalTypeOfGangText:
You can add an additional type to a gang or expert by spending two crew upgrades.
When a cohort performs actions for which its types apply, it uses its full quality rating. Otherwise, its quality is zero. A given cohort can have up to two types. Some crew upgrades will add the “Elite” feature to a gang, which gives them +1d when they roll for a given Type.
BITD.ClassExpClue1: Every time you roll a desperate action or a zero-dot action, mark xp in any attribute of your choice.
BITD.ClassExpClue2: Once per session when you hit a key, mark 1 xp and mark the key.
BITD.ClassExpClue3: You struggled with issues stemming from a deadlock.
BITD.ClassExpClueDescription: At the end of each session, mark 1 xp (or 2xp if you really smashed it) if:
BITD.CrewExpClue1: At the end of each session, for each item below, mark 1 xp (or instead mark 2xp if that item occurred multiple times).
BITD.NoClassSelected: Drop a "Class" item onto the sheet to see its Special Abilities here.
BITD.NoAbilitiesAdded: No Special Abilities added yet. Use the + button to add one.
BITD.GangTypeRoversDescription: Sailors, carriage drivers, and deathlands scavengers.
BITD.EdgesFearsomeDescription: The cohort is terrifying in aspect and reputation.
BITD.EdgesIndependentDescription: The cohort can be trusted to make good decisions and act on their own initiative in the absence of direct orders.
BITD.EdgesLoyalDescription: The cohort can't be bribed or turned against you.
BITD.EdgesTenaciousDescription: The cohort won't be deterred from a task.
BITD.FlawsPrincipledDescription: The cohort has an ethic or values that it won't betray.
BITD.FlawsSavageDescription: The cohort is excessively violent and cruel.
BITD.FlawsUnreliableDescription: The cohort isn't always available, due to other obligations, stupefaction from their vices, etc.
BITD.FlawsWildDescription: The cohort is drunken, debauched, and loud-mouthed.
BITD.HarmImpairedDescription: The cohort operates with reduced quality (-1d).
BITD.HarmBrokenDescription: The cohort can't do anything until they recover.
BITD.HarmDeadDescription: The cohort is destroyed. You can spend coin equal to your Tier +2 to restore it, plus two downtime activities to recruit new gang members, or hire a new expert.
BITD.RollPartialSuccessPositionControlle: You hesitate. Withdraw and try a different approach, or else do it with a minor consequence: a minor complication occurs, you have reduced effect, you suffer lesser harm, you end up in a risky position.
BITD.RollPartialSuccessPositionRisky: You do it, but there's a consequence: you suffer harm, a complication occurs, you have reduced effect, you end up in a desperate position.
BITD.RollPartialSuccessPosition: You do it, but there's a consequence: you suffer severe harm, a serious complication occurs, you have reduced effect.
BITD.RollFailurePositionControlled: You falter. Press on by seizing a risky opportunity, or withdraw and try a different approach.
BITD.RollFailurePositionRisky: Things go badly. You suffer harm, a complication occurs, you end up in a desperate position, you lose this opportunity.
BITD.RollFailurePositionDesperate: It's the worst outcome. You suffer severe harm, a serious complication occurs, you lose this opportunity for action.
BITD.RollResistance:
You reduce or avoid the effects of the consequence (GM chooses).
Suffer {stress} stress.
BITD.RollResistanceCritical:
You reduce or avoid the effects of the consequence (GM chooses).
Clear 1 stress.
BITD.RollThreatPeril: Suffer a reduced consequence or push yourself to avoid the threat.
BITD.RollThreatThreat: You suffer the consequence If you push yourself, reduce the consequence.
BITD.SkillsInsightContext: Resist consequences from deception or understanding.
BITD.SkillsHuntContext: Hunt a target; gather information about its location and movements; attack with precision shooting from a distance.
BITD.SkillsStudyContext: Study a person, document, or item with close scrutiny to gather information and apply knowledge; gain a deeper understanding; do research.
BITD.SkillsSurveyContext: Survey a location or situation to understand what's going on; sense trouble before it happens; gather information about opportunities or exploits.
BITD.SkillsTinkerContext: Tinker with mechanisms to create, modify, disable, or repair; disable a trap, pick a lock, or crack a safe. Turn the many mechanical and electroplasmic devices around the city to your advantage.
BITD.SkillsProwessContext: Resist consequences from physical strain or injury.
BITD.SkillsFinesseContext: Finesse an item from someone's pocket; employ subtle misdirection or sleight-of-hand; handle a vehicle or a mount.
BITD.SkillsProwlContext: Prowl about unseen and traverse obstacles; climb, swim, run, jump, and tumble. Ambush with close violence — a backstab, throat cutting, black-jack, etc.
BITD.SkillsSkirmishContext: Skirmish with an opponent in close combat; assault or hold a position; brawl and wrestle.
BITD.SkillsWreckContext: Wreck a place, item, or obstacle with savage force or carefully applied sabotage; breach defenses with force; create distractions and chaos.
BITD.SkillsResolveContext: Resist consequences from mental strain or willpower.
BITD.SkillsAttuneContext: Attune to spirits and the ghost field; channel electroplasmic energy; perceive and communicate with ghosts; understand spectrology.
BITD.SkillsCommandContext: Command obedience with your force of personality; intimidate or threaten; lead an action with one of the crew's gangs.
BITD.SkillsConsortContext: Consort with connections from your heritage, background, friends, or rivals to gain access to resources, information, people, or places.
BITD.SkillsSwayContext: Sway someone with charm, logic, deception, disguise, or bluff; change attitudes or behavior with manipulation or seduction.
BITD.EffectWarning: Managing Active Effects within an Owned Item is not currently supported by FoundryVTT and will be added in a subsequent update.
BITD.Name: Name
BITD.RollOptionAssist: Get an Assist: +1d if an ally helps (they take 1 stress).
BITD.RollOptionGambit: Spend a Gambit: +1d, if your crew has one available to spend.
BITD.RollOptionPush: Push Yourself: +1d, take 2 stress (can't also take a Devil's Bargain).
BITD.RollOptionDevilsBargain: Devil's Bargain: +1d, accept the GM's complication (can't also Push Yourself).
BITD.RollOptionGroupAction: Group Action: everyone involved rolls; use the best single result.
BITD.RollOptionSetupAction: Setup Action: on a success, improve position or effect for the next roll.
BITD.RollOptionResist: Roll the chosen attribute: on a 6 you clear the consequence at no cost (or for free with a matched pair of 6s); otherwise suffer stress equal to 6 minus your highest die.
BITD.RollOptionIndulgeVice: Roll your Vice dice: you clear stress equal to your highest die. Rolling under your current stress risks overindulgence — the GM introduces a complication.
BITD.AcquireAssetExtra: To raise the result beyond critical, you may spend 2 coin per +1 Tier bonus.
BITD.RollViceFailure: You overindulge. Clear {clear_stress} stress and choose one of the following consequences:
BITD.RollViceFailureAttactTrouble: Attract Trouble. Select or roll an additional entanglement.
BITD.RollViceFailureLost: Lost. Your character vanishes for a few weeks. Play a different character until this one returns from their bender. When your character returns, they've also healed any harm they had.
BITD.RollViceFailureTapped: Tapped. Your current purveyor cuts you off. Find a new source for your vice.
BITD.RollFortuneCritical: The result is exceptional. You have great or extreme effect.
BITD.RollFortuneSuccess: The result is good. You have standard or full effect.
BITD.RollFortunePartialSuccess: The result is mixed. You have limited or partial effect.
BITD.RollFortuneFailure: The result is bad. You have poor or little effect.
BITD.RollGatherInformationSuccess: Great: You get exceptional details. The information is complete and follow-up questions may expand into related areas or reveal more than you hoped for.
BITD.RollGatherInformationPartialSuccess: Standard: You get good details. Clarifying and follow-up questions are possible.
BITD.RollGatherInformationFailure: Limited: You get incomplete or partial information. More information gathering will be needed to get all the answers.
BITD.RollEngagementCritical: Exceptional result. You've already overcome the first obstacle and you're in a controlled position for what's next.
BITD.RollEngagementSuccess: Good result. You're in a controlled position when the action starts.
BITD.RollEngagementPartialSuccess: Mixed result. You're in a risky position when the action starts.
BITD.RollEngagementFailure: Bad result. You're in a desperate position when the action starts.
BITD.RollAcquireAssetResult: You gain an asset of Tier {tier_quality} quality.
BITD.DisabledByAE: Minimum Value set by an Active Effect
BITD.MemoryBlurb: Whenever you would mark playbook xp, you can tick a memory clock instead. When the clock is full, fill in the memory. You also remember: One key of your choice, a human contact, and a special ability from another playbook.
BITD.MemoryClock1: What was my name and heritage?
BITD.MemoryClock3: What was my background? Who or what did I love most in life?
BITD.MemoryClock4: What crime was I sentenced to be Reformed for?
BITD.Memory1Blurb: Add a former friend (choose from friends of other players), key, and special ability
BITD.Memory2Blurb: Add a former friend (choose from friends of other players), key, and special ability
BITD.Memory3Blurb: Add a former friend (choose from rivals of other players), key, and special ability
BITD.Memory4Blurb: Remember a rival (someone powerful and dangerous), key, and special ability
BITD.MemoryFillAbility: Whenever you fill a memory clock, choose another playbook and roll 1d8. Use your result to count down the list of abilities from the top, and take that one. If it involves special items, you get those too. How did you acquire these items?
BITD.MemoryAllComplete: When all four memories complete, replace first xp trigger with this one: You worked to free yourself from your owning faction and controller, or you addressed a challenge with your humanity.
BITD.HousingSmall: Small (wristwatch, a metal orb, a tiny hull, etc). Less powerful but highly portable.
BITD.HousingLarge: Large (room-sized computer). More powerful, but immobile.
BITD.FactionAffiliationInfo: As an Operative, you start play with a backing faction. Is it the Palace, Blackthorn Park, or another faction? They may give you a personal mission. Complete this personal mission to gain that faction’s prestige ability.
BITD.ExplosivesHeat: Take +1 heat if explosives are used during a score
BITD.WhenYouUseBandolier: When you use a bandolier slot, choose an explosive.
BITD.AutopodStyle: Style (Velvet or leather upholstery, wood detailing, chrome finish, racing stripe, etc)
BITD.VeteranUsedAndDiscardedInfo: You have permanent damage from the war. You start with 1 deadlocked key already. You also start with the special ability Military Discipline and one more of your choice.
BITD.VetDamageInfo: E.g. a notable scar, a missing eye or limb, nightmares, the shakes
BITD.VetHelpsInfo: E.g. a wheelchair, a prosthetic, medication
BITD.StricturesBlurb: When you gain a new Vampiric trait (except versatile), add a stricture. You start with the Dayfire stricture already.
BITD.StricturesDayfire: Dayfire: When your skin is exposed to bluetime, take a new level 1 harm (“Burned”) every few minutes.
BITD.StricturesSlumber: Slumber: In downtime, you must spend one activity resting in a dark, silent place (or else suffer 3 Stress).
BITD.StricturesForbidden: Forbidden: You cannot enter a private residence without permission from the owner.
BITD.StricturesRepelled: Repelled: Spiritbane charms can hold you at bay. (Take 2 Stress to resist the repulsion.)
BITD.StricturesBestial: Bestial: When you suffer physical harm or overindulge your vice, your body twists into a horrific bestial form until you next feed without overindulging.
BITD.StricturesBound: Bound: Your spirit must remain in this body, or be destroyed.
BITD.ChooseMission: Choose a mission—the reason you travelled back through time. Add a new detail when you gain a new temporal glitch.
BITD.PreventTerribleFutureBlurb: You come from a future where things went bad; you’ve come back to stop that happening.
BITD.TerribleFuture3: 3. Why did you choose this crew?
BITD.ChaseDownBadBlurb: Something or someone dangerous came here from your time, and you followed to stop them.
BITD.ChasingBad2: 2. What did they do in the future?
BITD.ChasingBad3: 3. Why did you choose this crew?
BITD.ChasingBad4: 4. Why did the enemy come here?

Action.Name: Action Rolls
Action.Hint: Enables the Action Roll from the Actor Dice Roller; only uncheck if you have enabled Threat Rolls.

Threat.Name: Threat Rolls
Threat.Hint: Enables the Threat Roll from the Deep Cuts supplement.

Push.Name: Push Yourself Rolls
Push.Hint: Replaces the base Resistance Roll with the Push Yourself Roll from the Deep Cuts supplement.

Load.Name: Alternate Load
Load.Hint: Replaces the base Load Rules (Light/Normal/Heavy) with the Load Rules (Discreet/Conspicuous) from the Deep Cuts supplement.

ClockXP.Name: Experience Clocks
ClockXP.Hint: Replaces the base Experience Rules with Experience Clocks from the Deep Cuts supplement.

Edge.Name: Edge
Edge.Hint: Adds Edge to character sheets from the Deep Cuts supplement.

PublicClocks.Name: Default Observable Clocks
PublicClocks.Hint: All newly made Clock actors will have permissions set to Observer for all players.

Blades68.Name: Blades '68 Mode
Blades68.Hint: Replaces the character sheet's Trauma section with Keys & Deadlocks and applies the Blades '68 bright color theme.

info.SameNPC: The dropped NPC is already an acquaintance of this character.
info.SameCrew: The dropped Crew is the current crew of this character.

warn.NoNPC: This NPC does not exist in the World or in a Compendium.
